reportAudit.finding: Provides bill, order, KOT, user and timestamp, but has no item/status/reason fields and cannot independently prove cancellations.
reportAudit.correction: Join to immutable KOT events by KOT ID; add opened, modified, cancelled and settled timestamps.

reportAudit.finding: Confirms AED 13 Fattoush as complimentary and records actor/time/reason, but its numeric KOT reference differs from the KOT event ID.
reportAudit.correction: Export immutable order ID, bill number, KOT ID and invoice line ID. The current row can only be contextually linked to #2990.

reportAudit.finding: Shows 0 units and AED 0.00; average price is already net of discounts but the report has no discount/VAT bridge.
reportAudit.correction: Add gross, item discount, allocated order discount, net incl VAT, VAT and net ex VAT.

reportAudit.finding: Gross Sales AED 118,650.96, Taxes AED 4,290.75 and Net Total AED 121,685.21 do not expose charges or a governed bridge to invoice revenue.
reportAudit.correction: Use transaction line facts, separate discounts by level, and reconcile item net incl VAT plus separately classified charges to invoice sales.

reportAudit.finding: 103 cancelled lines (122 qty; list value AED 4,794.00) and 3 edited lines are visible, but cancel action time and approver are absent.
reportAudit.correction: Store one append-only status event per action with event timestamp, actor, approver, reason code and previous/new values.

reportAudit.finding: Gross Sale AED 118,597.20, Discount on Item AED 13.00, and Net Amount AED 114,981.05. Item discount is zero despite the confirmed AED 13 complimentary line.
reportAudit.correction: Do not infer discount from zero price. Persist original price and complimentary/item discount as separate fields before aggregation.
